title: Changing Class Numbers in Subject Authority Records
summary: LC class numbers for subject headings are in 053 fields, one per number or span. Changes limited to 053 fields are handled off-list by PTCP: catalogers email a subject policy specialist (preferred) or submit an annotated printout. Changes involving other fields follow the procedures for those changes (e.g. H 195). Not relevant to heading-string validation.
validation_rules: [LC practice] Each class number or span associated with a heading is a separate 053 field, formulated per H 365 (e.g. `053 QD380-QD388 (Chemistry)`). (H 196 Background, sec. 2.a)

[LC practice] Changes limited to 053 fields are processed off-list (not on a tentative list); email a subject policy specialist (preferred) or submit an annotated printout. (H 196 Background, sec. 1, 2)
[LC practice] If other fields change along with the 053, follow the procedures for those changes (e.g. H 195) instead. (H 196 Background note)

sections.heading: 1. Emailing a subject policy specialist
sections.text: Include in the email the heading and a description of the revision to be made (i.e., revise an existing 053, add or delete an 053). Include the class number(s) in the email. This method is preferred over the method described in sec. 2.

sections.heading: a. Preparing the printout
sections.text:
In order to add, change, or delete an 053 field in a subject authority record, make a printout of the record. Annotate the printout, using red ink if possible, by editing or crossing off existing 053 fields that need to be changed or deleted. Add new 053s by writing instructions in a blank area on the printout, for example,

```
add: 053 QD380-QD388 (Chemistry)
add: 053 QP801.P64 (Biochemistry)
```

sections.heading: b. Submitting the proposal
sections.text: Write your cataloger's code and the date on the printout. Submit the proposal to the Policy, Training, and Cooperative Programs Division. After the proposal has been reviewed and approved in PTCP, the authority record in Classification Web will be updated to reflect the change.
